text:
name: routing_follow_up
question: >-
  Can deepseek-v4-pro activate the per-step routing layer per docs/routing_next_steps.md —
  wire the signal store from measured experiment results, surface routing validation in the
  Control Room, and apply the hygiene fixes (items 1, 2, and 5) — leaving signal
  instrumentation and the routing campaign as separate follow-ups?
version: "0.1"
workflow:
  kind: agent_task
  params:
    language: python
    fork: true
    phases:
      - name: signal_store
        kind: agent
        prompt: |
          Implement the signal-store wiring (docs/routing_next_steps.md item 1) and write
          docs/routing_signal_store_notes.md.
